tools.name: slice_run
tools.title: Slice project
tools.description: Slice the current project with the current settings. May take from seconds to minutes depending on model complexity. Returns per-plate results: status (sliced/failed/skipped-empty), estimated print time, filament used, and any slicing errors or warnings. Detailed statistics are available afterwards via slice_analyze. Re-slicing after settings changes replaces the previous result.

plate_id.description: Slice only this plate (1-based). Omit to slice all non-empty plates.

tools.name: slice_analyze
tools.title: Analyze slice result
tools.description: Return statistics from the most recent slice_run. 'summary' (default): per-plate print time, filament weight/length/cost, layer count, warnings count. 'features': per-feature-type breakdown (walls, infill, supports, ...) of time, volume, and speed ranges — useful for finding what dominates print time or where flow limits bind. 'warnings': full list of slicing warnings with locations (e.g. overhangs, thin walls, low bed adhesion). Fails with SLICE_STALE if settings changed since the last slice.

plate_id.description: Restrict to one plate (1-based). Omit for all sliced plates.

tools.name: gcode_export
tools.title: Export G-code or sliced 3MF
tools.description: Write the most recent slice result to disk. format 'gcode' writes one .gcode file per plate; format '3mf' writes a single .3mf containing geometry, settings, and sliced plate data (the format Bambu/Orca printers and network plugins consume). Returns the written file paths and sizes. Fails with SLICE_STALE if settings changed since the last slice, and NOT_SLICED if slice_run has not been run.

output_path.description: Absolute file path (single plate or 3mf) or directory (multiple plates).

plate_id.description: Export only this plate (1-based). Omit for all sliced plates.
